svg.title: The agent deployment loop
svg.desc: Step 1: Claude reads the Compute docs, writes a deploy script, and runs the Prisma CLI. Step 2: Prisma Compute builds and hosts the app, many pages in one app. Step 3: a live URL is ready to open, share, and put in the outreach email. The loop then repeats for the next website, about 50 in one night.

g.text: repeats for the next website: ~50 in one night
